svg.title: Latitude-depth portrait of the native Drake Passage gate
svg.desc: A nonlinear-depth cross-section from the Antarctic Peninsula toward South America shows four-sample mean potential temperature, with sampled dot symbols for eastward velocity out of the page and cross symbols for westward velocity into the page.
svg.text: OSW / HEAT MOTION · M3 NATIVE SECTION PORTRAIT
67.125°W · four sampled 2018 months · temperature field + cross-section-normal velocity
The warmer eastward core spans much of the passage; colder counterflow is embedded within and beneath it rather than forming one simple surface ribbon.
NONLINEAR DEPTH DISPLAY · VELOCITY SYMBOLS SAMPLED FOR LEGIBILITY · FOUR MONTHS, NOT AN ANNUAL MEAN OR CLIMATOLOGY · NOT WATER-MASS BOUNDARIES OR HEAT CONVERGENCE
svg.metadata: Arithmetic mean of February, May, August, and November 2018 native-section cells. The nonlinear display depth scale and sampled velocity marks are visual encodings, not transport integration, water-mass boundaries, an annual mean, or a climatology.
